stance_target: rapid, not physically slow, manufacturing diversification
scope_conditions: India iPhone assembly, FY ended March 2025, per Bloomberg sources familiar with the matter

claim: Apple is unlikely to move iPhone production to the US despite Trump administration pressure, due to a shortage of facilities and labor needed to produce the devices.
stance_target: feasibility of US reshoring as a supply-chain diversification path
scope_conditions: 2025, in context of Trump tariff policy
quoted_support: Despite Trump's ambition to have iPhones made in the US, Apple is unlikely to move production there any time soon due to factors including a shortage of facilities and labor needed to produce the devices.

claim: Trump's China-specific cumulative tariffs remained at 145% even after smartphones/electronics were exempted from broader 'reciprocal' tariffs, creating continued pressure for supply-chain diversification away from China.
stance_target: tariff exposure as a forcing function accelerating (not slowing) diversification
quoted_support: Barring the exceptions made Friday, Trump's cumulative levies on China remain at 145%, and will likely force companies such as Apple to intensify their supply chain shift.

claim: Apple has roughly 8% market share in India's smartphone market, with India sales (mostly iPhones) reaching almost $8 billion in fiscal 2024.
stance_target: India as a demand market for Apple, distinct from India as a manufacturing base
